entries.title: Bar Magnets and Iron Filings Field Sandbox
entries.description: A set of draggable bar magnets on a light floor with thousands of tiny metallic particles that rotate and align into field lines, forming chains and clusters that attach, detach, and rearrange as magnets move and flip polarity, with colored field-line trails and labels for north/south poles.

entries.title: Magnetic Dipole Orbiting a Current Loop
entries.description: A glowing current-carrying loop (wire ring) fixed in space with a small magnetic dipole (arrow-tipped rod) that can orbit, precess, and wobble around the loop, showing animated torque arrows, changing angular momentum vectors, and color-coded field strength regions.
entries.seed: Magnetic Dipole Orbiting a Current Loop: A glowing current-carrying loop (wire ring) fixed in space with a small magnetic dipole (arrow-tipped rod) that can orbit, precess, and wobble around the loop, showing animated torque arrows, changing angular momentum vectors, and color-coded field strength regions.

entries.title: Floating Magnetic Levitating Train Track
entries.description: A straight or curved track made of fixed magnetic rails with a train car that levitates slightly above using repulsive magnets, sliding, accelerating, and braking along the track, with visible force vectors, gentle oscillations, and a slider to adjust magnetic strength.

entries.title: Magnetic Pendulum with Multiple Attractors
entries.description: A bob with a magnet swings over a flat plate that holds several stationary magnets in different colors; the pendulum path traces a trail as it is attracted, repelled, and chaotically redirected, eventually settling above one attractor, with regions of influence subtly color-mapped on the floor.

entries.title: Magnetic Stirrer Mixing Colored Fluid Particles
entries.description: A transparent beaker holds hundreds of small colored “fluid” spheres and a magnetic bar at the bottom that rotates when an external magnet (user-draggable) moves around beneath, causing the bar to spin, particles to swirl, mix, and form visible vortices and trails.

entries.title: Electromagnet Coil with Adjustable Current
entries.description: A stationary cylindrical coil with a visible helical wire glows brighter as current increases, pulling in nearby loose iron spheres that roll, bounce, and cluster around its ends, while a dynamic color gradient shows field strength and a meter displays current and induced magnetization.

entries.title: Earth-like Planetary Magnetic Field and Solar Wind
entries.description: A rotating sphere representing Earth sits at the center, with animated magnetic field lines arcing from pole to pole while a stream of charged particles (solar wind) flows past, being deflected around the planet, trapped in belts, and occasionally funneled toward the poles as aurora-like glows.

entries.title: Magnetic Domain Alignment in a Metal Rod
entries.description: A rectangular metal bar is filled with tiny randomly oriented arrows (domains) that gradually rotate and align as an external magnet passes alongside, with domains flipping in clusters, some resisting and then snapping into alignment, and a bar at the side showing net magnetization.

entries.title: Magnetically Coupled Rotating Gears
entries.description: Two or three disk “gears” with magnets embedded around their rims hover with a small gap and rotate without contact; spinning one disk causes others to spin via magnetic attraction/repulsion, with torque arrows, colored poles on the rims, and occasional slipping when misaligned.
